detailZones.title: Left baggage-drop module
detailZones.description: Start at the left weighing platform, then follow the belt behind it past the display and paper roll.

detailZones.title: Center conveyor lane
detailZones.description: Compare the dark belt under the smooth suitcase with the bank of exposed silver rollers in front of it.

detailZones.title: Right baggage-drop module
detailZones.description: Find the low right-hand scale in front of its cabinet and compare its screen, printer and scanning arch.

detailZones.title: Scanning and tag equipment
detailZones.description: Find a handheld scanner and its stand, the visible paper outlet and both small counter displays.

detailZones.title: Suitcases and visible parts
detailZones.description: Distinguish the ribbed case from the smooth case and locate their exposed carrying handles.

detailZones.title: Cabinet panels and fittings
detailZones.description: Compare the upright panels with the low scale bases and find the recessed handle on the left cabinet door.

detailZones.title: Floor and platform rails
detailZones.description: Follow a tile joint across the foreground and locate the short fixed rail and its foot on the scale.

anchorAudit.rationale: The two freestanding dark loading platforms in front of the cabinets identify the left and right baggage scales. The belts run behind and between them. The photograph also distinguishes two suitcases, the exposed front rollers, the handheld scanners, paper feeds, cabinet panels and fixed rails. Terms without a separate, visible referent in this image are available as related words.
